segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone oily skin consistently report clearer pores, fewer breakouts, and a more balanced, less oily complexion, though one cautions that overusing it can dry the skin out and trigger a rebound in oil production.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin have mixed experiences: some say it doesn't add dryness and even keeps their skin glowy, while others say it didn't help their existing dryness and needed a moisturizer afterward, or caution that it can be drying if you're already dry.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it is gentle and non-irritating, with clearer skin and smaller-looking pores, though results can take a couple of weeks to show.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are mostly positive, including several who tolerated it well despite a history of rosacea or reactivity to wind, reporting clearer, more even skin with no visible reaction; dissent comes from two who say it was still too strong to use over their entire face and one whose open blemishes stung on application.
segments.normal: The one reviewer who describes her skin as normal to dry says it quickly healed a persistent blemish patch near her mouth without causing peeling.

concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers say the serum doesn't strip moisture and even feels hydrating; dissent is common too, with several noting it leaves skin feeling dry unless followed by a moisturizer, and one describing lasting dryness and itching after a burning reaction.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness, including one with a rosacea history who had no visible reaction and another whose deep breakout redness cleared within a week; one reviewer, however, reports the serum worsened her redness along with irritation and breakouts.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report fading acne scars, post-acne dark marks, and lingering red spots with continued use, including one with a deeper skin tone who saw her post-acne hyperpigmentation lighten.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers, including many who describe themselves as acne-prone, report clearer skin, fewer breakouts, and reduced blackheads, sometimes within one to two weeks; dissent comes from two reviewers who say it made their acne or breakouts worse.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers report their skin looks and feels less oily with regular use; one, however, cautions that overuse can dry the skin out and trigger a rebound increase in oil production.

extraits.titre: I would NOT purchase this product!
extraits.texte: I used VICHY Normaderm BHA Exfoliating Serum as directed on its label, just a few drops. I repeated this method for 1 week. I had a rather unpleasant experience with this product. Extreme irritation, worsened breakouts and redness.

I received this product for free to try out. I have highly acne prone skin. I felt this product made my acne worse. It also dried out the acne spots I had at the time. In my personal opinion, I wouldn't purchase this product but each person's skin is different. Give it a try for yourself.

extraits.titre: Too strong for my sensitive skin type
extraits.texte: I was very pleased with the ingredients in this product but unfortunately, even using as directed, this product was still too strong for my sensitive skin. I try using it on just some acne spots and it did work very well with drying out my acne spots but I could not use this all over my entire face as instructed on the box. I like that it was fragrance free and I do love other Vichy products but sadly this just did not work for me. I would recommend this product to others who struggle with acne but with the fare warning that it did not work well with my skin type.

The applicator is very easy to use. I've seen people say it was tricky, but I don't think they could make it any simpler. It's literally twist on and twist off and squeeze. The only way to improve would be to make the applicator already included on the bottle instead of having to add it and/or remove it. It's supposed to prevent contamination, but I still don't get the extra step. I have drier skin so this did not help with that. Which isn't a big deal as my normal face wash cause some dryness as well, so a good moisturizer works wonders. Once I moisturize the dryness is no issue at all. I don't have to much trouble with breakouts but I am loving how clear my skin is. I occasionally get a pimple here or there and this has stopped the random breakouts. The best part is that my pores are so much smaller. Seriously cannot get over how much better my skin looks. A small amount goes a long way. I like that it's not sticky and doesn't leave a residue on my skin. It does have a strong scent. It's a sting almost minty scent that comes from it. Not a big fan of that. My biggest complaints are the applicator and scent. If the scent could be minimized and the applicator included right on the bottle (instead of having to swap the lid for applicator). It is a bit pricy for the size of the bottle. Though I will say due to the small amount needed the bottle would probably last a good while. Overall a decent product with minor issues.

extraits.titre: This is a really great product!
extraits.texte: I was fortunate enough to receive this from BzzAgent to try and provide my honest review. Although I'll be approaching my 40s in a few years, I still struggle with adult and hormonal acne. I've tried lots of and lots of other acne medications including tretinoin which would leave my face raw and dry regardless if I used it once a week. I have combo/oily skin and large pores on my nose. I have been using this Vichy BHA exfoliating serum once every few days...usually at night, but if I use a retinol at night I'll use this in the morning....just make sure you wear a spf! I have notice a big improvement in the clarity of my skin including my pores looking more clean. This hasn't dried my skin out or irritated it and seems to be a gentle formula as my skin can be sensitive. You only need a couple of drops to cover your entire face and neck. This doesn't appear to have a strong fragrance in it if any and is easily absorbed in the skin. The only reason I took of 1 star is because denatured alcohol is the second or third ingredient which can dry my skin out and make it more oily which is why I don'tuse this product daily. I do try to avoid products with denatured alcohol in it. Overall I will keep using this as it has helped with my acne, pores and skin texture and plan on purchasing it once I use this. As long as I use it every few days I haven't had issues with my skin getting fry/flaky or increasing my oil production!

To start I follow a skin cycling regimen therefore I used this Normaderm BHA exfoliating serum on my exfoliating days for a little more than 2 weeks to get the full effect. Some days I used it for my morning and night routine and it did help the clearing of mild hormonal breakouts I have had. It worked well with my routine not causing any tingling or irritation like my usual nightly exfoliating serum which I couldn't dare use in the day time. I'd like to note while using this product I was very diligent about using a sunscreen with at least 30spf during the day. I'm black with caramel brown skin that has mild hyperpigmentation and I believe this product has assisted with helping to lighten my post acne hyperpigmentation as well as clear up my breakouts faster than usual. I will continue to include in my regimen because it has had great results thus far.

I took a while to use the product because I wanted to make sure that I gave it the full time to work (or not). Background: I have sensitive skin with a history of rosacea with red, dry, and flaky skin. I was nervous to give it a go but did as I had fairly large pores on my nose with a ton visible blackheads. I started by using it once a day and worked up to three times a day with no visible reaction at all in my problem areas. While I can't say it happened overnight (pushing a month of consistent use) I can see that the blackheads are much less prominent and a smoother/cleaner appearance in general! I did only put the serum on my nose so i cannot speak to how any of the rest of your face (or your skin in general) would respond but I can say that it certainly worked for me! I plan to make this a regular pert of my skincare routine!
